parameters.notes: Attribution as Bakaric 2019 describes it: the literature curve for water 'was calculated using the approximation Gamma(T) = 0.0053T + 0.0043 derived from the definition of the Gruneisen parameter' (Eq. 2, Gamma = beta c^2/C_p as extracted) 'and knowledge of the temperature dependence of the speed of sound, volume expansion thermal coefficient and specific heat under constant volume for water and aqueous solutions [14]', where [14] is Wang & Wu 2012. check.claim: Speed of sound in soft tissue about 1,540 m/s
check.evidence: Wang 2008 p.174 uses 1.54 mm/us; Culjat 2010 Table 1 (Mast 2000) soft-tissue average 1561 m/s; tissue range 1430 (fat) to 1595 (liver) m/s

check.claim: Transport mean free path about 1 mm in NIR tissue
check.evidence: 0.964 mm at 800 nm from Jacques 2013 Table 2 soft-tissue mean; 0.42 (skin) to 0.97 mm across tissue means; 0.63-2.08 mm across +/-1 SD of a; Zhou 2016 states ~1 mm; Wang 2008 states only that the 1 mm penetration limit is approximately correlated with l_tr

check.claim: A single cell is 10 to 20 um across
check.evidence: BioNumbers BNID 100432: 15 um, range 10-20 um for mammalian tissue culture cells; but human RBC 7.7 um and lymphocyte ~7 um fall below
